mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO review_task (task_id, target_type, target_id, review_round, author_id, source, claim_state, entered_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reviewRound}, #{authorId}, #{source}, 'PENDING', NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE review_task SET claim_by = #{claimBy}, claim_state = 'CLAIMED', claim_seq = claim_seq + 1, lease_expire_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseMinutes} MINUTE), update_time = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND claim_state = 'PENDING'
mapper.sql: SET claim_state = 'PENDING', claim_by = NULL, lease_expire_at = NULL, escalated = IF(recycle_count + 1 >= 3, 1, escalated), recycle_count = recycle_count + 1, update_time = NOW()
mapper.update:
UPDATE review_task
WHERE claim_state = 'CLAIMED' AND lease_expire_at < NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM review_task WHERE escalated = 1 AND claim_state = 'PENDING'

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM review_task WHERE claim_state = 'PENDING'
AND target_type = #{targetType}
SELECT target_type AS targetType, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM review_task WHERE claim_state = 'PENDING' GROUP BY target_type

SELECT COUNT(1) AS pendingCnt, COALESCE(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, entered_at, NOW())), 0) AS avgWaitSeconds, COALESCE(MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, entered_at, NOW())), 0) AS oldestWaitSeconds FROM review_task WHERE claim_state = 'PENDING'

choose.when: SELECT 'POST' AS targetType, p.post_id AS targetId, p.review_round AS reviewRound, p.user_id AS authorId, CONCAT(COALESCE(p.title, ''), p.content) AS content, NULL AS reward, p.images AS images, p.state AS status, p.create_time AS createTime FROM post p WHERE p.post_id = #{targetId}

SELECT 'COMMENT' AS targetType, c.comment_id AS targetId, 1 AS reviewRound, c.user_id AS authorId, c.content AS content, NULL AS reward, c.state AS status, c.create_time AS createTime FROM post_comment c WHERE c.comment_id = #{targetId}

SELECT 'PRODUCT' AS targetType, p.product_id AS targetId, p.review_round AS reviewRound, p.user_id AS authorId, CONCAT(COALESCE(p.title, ''), p.description) AS content, p.price AS reward, p.images AS images, p.state AS status, p.create_time AS createTime FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = #{targetId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT 'ERRAND' AS targetType, e.errand_order_id AS targetId, 1 AS reviewRound, e.publisher_id AS authorId, e.description AS content, e.reward AS reward, e.images AS images, e.state AS status, e.create_time AS createTime FROM errand_order e WHERE e.errand_order_id = #{targetId}

mapper.select: SELECT task_id, target_type, target_id, review_round, author_id, source, claim_state, claim_by, claim_seq, lease_expire_at, recycle_count, escalated, entered_at, decided_at, create_time, update_time FROM review_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.sql: SELECT 'POST' AS targetType, p.post_id AS targetId, p.user_id AS authorId, CONCAT(COALESCE(p.title, ''), p.content) AS content, p.images, NULL AS reward, p.state AS status, NULL AS contextPostId, NULL AS contextPostTitle, NULL AS contextParentId, NULL AS contextParentContent FROM post p WHERE p.post_id = #{targetId}

SELECT 'COMMENT' AS targetType, c.comment_id AS targetId, c.user_id AS authorId, c.content AS content, c.images, NULL AS reward, c.state AS status, c.post_id AS contextPostId, NULL AS contextPostTitle,
CASE WHEN c.parent_id <> '0' THEN c.parent_id END AS contextParentId, NULL AS contextParentContent FROM post_comment c WHERE c.comment_id = #{targetId}

SELECT 'PRODUCT' AS targetType, p.product_id AS targetId, p.user_id AS authorId, CONCAT(COALESCE(p.title, ''), p.description) AS content, p.images, p.price AS reward, p.state AS status, NULL AS contextPostId, NULL AS contextPostTitle, NULL AS contextParentId, NULL AS contextParentContent FROM product p WHERE p.product_id = #{targetId}

SELECT 'ERRAND' AS targetType, e.errand_order_id AS targetId, e.publisher_id AS authorId, e.description AS content, e.images, e.reward, e.state AS status, NULL AS contextPostId, NULL AS contextPostTitle, NULL AS contextParentId, NULL AS contextParentContent FROM errand_order e WHERE e.errand_order_id = #{targetId}
